title: Biomass as a transportable biogenic carbon carrier for e-methanol production: Techno-economic comparison with CO2 transport and direct air capture
summary: Paper in Biomass and Bioenergy by Namdarpour Naghani, Galimova, Mensah, Koiranen and Breyer. As its title states, it compares transporting biomass as a biogenic carbon carrier for e-methanol production with CO2 transport and direct air capture in a techno-economic analysis.
why_it_matters: Provides an alternative to CO2 transport (moving biomass instead of CO2), relevant when weighing transport mode and supply-chain configuration for biogenic CO2 in the Nordics.
authors: Sina Namdarpour Naghani, Tansu Galimova, Theophilus Nii Odai Mensah, Tuomas Koiranen, Christian Breyer
approved_by: Published automatically (before the review step existed)
